title: Replay of #14: a prompt that starts no work is typed again, and a worker it never reaches is reported blocked (issue #10)
notes: Source a3bcb63 (the parent of PR #14), hidden tests from its merge 1bc830e (tests/ replaced whole). testsChanged is true: PR #14 changed tests/workers.test.tsx. The issue is the real one (all four comments were posted before the PR), with an Acceptance details block added: the reference test checks the exact blocked wording (The worker stopped (its prompt was not delivered: no work started after 3 tries)) and the 10 s timings, which the issue gives only as 'prompt not delivered'. The three tries and the agent_prompt_stalled idea are the issue's own proposed fix. The fake herdr in the merge's tests/harness.tsx answers the next N `agent prompt --wait` calls of a worker with agent_prompt_stalled (the stalls knob).
